sides.text: A company wants to prevent any account in an OU from disabling CloudTrail. What should they use?
options: A service control policy denying cloudtrail:StopLogging
A bucket policy on the trail bucket
An IAM permissions boundary on each user

sides.text: A. A service control policy denying cloudtrail:StopLogging

more.text: SCPs set maximum permissions across accounts and explicit deny wins.

sides.text: An EC2 application needs to read an S3 bucket. What is the most secure way to grant access?
options: Store access keys in the application code
Attach an IAM role with an instance profile

sides.text: B. Attach an IAM role with an instance profile

more.text: Roles provide temporary credentials that rotate automatically.

sides.text: Private instances need to reach S3 without traversing the internet and at no hourly cost. Which should be used?
C. A gateway VPC endpoint

more.text: Gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB are free.

sides.text: Which control can deny traffic from one specific IP address to a subnet?
D. Network ACL

more.text: Security groups have only allow rules.

sides.text: A company must encrypt data with keys it fully controls in single-tenant FIPS 140-2 Level 3 hardware. Which service?
A. AWS CloudHSM

more.text: CloudHSM gives dedicated HSMs that the customer manages.

sides.text: Which service automatically rotates database credentials?
B. AWS Secrets Manager

more.text: Secrets Manager supports rotation via Lambda.

sides.text: A mobile app users sign in with social identity providers. Which service manages sign-in and issues tokens?
C. Amazon Cognito user pools

more.text: User pools handle sign-up, sign-in, and federation.

sides.text: What protects a public web app behind an Application Load Balancer from SQL injection?
D. AWS WAF

more.text: WAF inspects HTTP requests.

sides.text: Which service identifies sensitive PII in S3 buckets?
A. Amazon Macie

more.text: Macie classifies data in S3.

sides.text: Which service detects a compromised instance communicating with known malicious IPs?
B. Amazon GuardDuty

more.text: GuardDuty analyzes DNS, VPC flow, and CloudTrail logs.

sides.text: A user has an IAM Allow for ec2:* but a permissions boundary that allows only s3:*. What can the user do?
C. Nothing in EC2

more.text: Effective permissions are the intersection.

sides.text: Which statement about security groups is true?
options: They are stateful and allow rules only

sides.text: D. They are stateful and allow rules only

more.text: Return traffic is allowed automatically.

sides.text: Employees should use corporate credentials to access several AWS accounts. Which service is best?
A. IAM Identity Center

more.text: It provides SSO with permission sets.

sides.text: Which key policy feature lets you audit every use of an S3 object's encryption key?
B. SSE-KMS with CloudTrail logging

more.text: KMS records key use in CloudTrail.

sides.text: Which combination encrypts private traffic between on-premises and AWS over Direct Connect?
options: A Site-to-Site VPN over Direct Connect

sides.text: C. A Site-to-Site VPN over Direct Connect

more.text: Direct Connect is private but not encrypted.

sides.text: Public ACM certificates can be attached to which resources?
D. ALB, CloudFront, and API Gateway

more.text: ACM public certificates cannot be exported.

sides.text: A company needs WORM storage for compliance. Which feature?
A. S3 Object Lock

more.text: Compliance mode prevents deletion during retention.

sides.text: An administrator must share a subnet with another account without copying it. Which service?
B. AWS Resource Access Manager

more.text: RAM shares resources across accounts.

sides.text: Which tool lets an auditor download AWS SOC reports on demand?
C. AWS Artifact

more.text: Artifact provides compliance documents.

sides.text: How should the root user be protected?
options: Enable MFA and avoid using it for daily tasks

sides.text: D. Enable MFA and avoid using it for daily tasks

more.text: Best practice is minimal use with MFA.

sides.text: Which type of policy is attached directly to an S3 bucket?
A. Resource-based policy

more.text: It names principals that may access the bucket.

sides.text: A Lambda function in a VPC must call a third-party API on the internet. What is needed?
options: A NAT gateway in a public subnet
An internet gateway on the private subnet

sides.text: B. A NAT gateway in a public subnet

more.text: Lambda in private subnets needs NAT for internet egress.

sides.text: Which service provides managed Microsoft Active Directory in AWS?
options: AWS Directory Service for Microsoft AD

sides.text: C. AWS Directory Service for Microsoft AD

more.text: AD Connector proxies to on-premises AD.

sides.text: What does an explicit deny do in IAM evaluation?
D. Overrides any allow

more.text: Explicit deny always wins.

sides.text: Which feature records IP traffic going to and from network interfaces?
A. VPC Flow Logs

more.text: Flow logs capture metadata, not payloads.
